effects.name: lifecycle-doc-read
effects.source: the repository working tree (docs/lifecycle.md, or the --output path) and the policy IR
effects.capture: whether the target file's bytes equal the Markdown generated from the IR; used only for the --check exit status

effects.name: lifecycle-doc-write
effects.system: the repository working tree (docs/lifecycle.md, or the --output path)
effects.detail: without --check, scripts/gen_lifecycle_doc.py writes deterministic Markdown generated from the policy IR, creating the parent directory; with --check it writes nothing and exits 1 when the file differs
